description: tether/project.py defines the state-directory name (TETHER_DIR = .tether, TETHERS_SUBDIR = tethers) that locates every tether record; tether/coverage.py independently hardcodes the .tether/ prefix (_TETHER_DIR_PREFIX) to exclude tether-owned files from the coverage denominator. The two must name the same directory: if project.py renames the state dir, coverage.py silently stops excluding it and coverage is deflated on exactly the projects using tether most.
